name: application-share-dialog
title: Share Dialog
description: Invite-by-email dialog with a role dropdown, member list with per-member role control, and a copy-link row, driven by a typed members prop contract.
useWhen: Sharing a document, project, or resource with specific people by email, each with their own access level.
Users need to see and adjust existing collaborators' roles alongside inviting new ones.
A general shareable-link option should sit alongside individual email invites.
avoidWhen: Only a single shareable link is needed with no per-person roles — a simpler Copy-to-Clipboard Field is enough.
You need to manage a large team's roles in bulk — use a dedicated members/settings page instead of a dialog.
The resource has no concept of granular roles (edit/view) — a plain invite list without a role selector is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The dialog is a fixed-width card meant to sit centered over a full-screen scrim; the invite row wraps its input/select/button as needed on narrow viewports.
accessibility: The dialog uses role='dialog' with aria-modal='true' and is labelled by its heading id.
The email field carries a visible placeholder and type='email' for correct keyboard and validation behavior.
Each member's role control is either a real <select> (editable) or plain text (fixed, e.g. Owner), never a non-interactive dropdown look-alike.

variants.title: Share Dialog
variants.description: Invite dialog with an email + role + invite row, a member list showing fixed Owner and editable role selects, and a copy-link footer row.
accessibility: The Owner role is shown as plain text since it isn't editable, avoiding a disabled-looking dropdown.

variants.title: Share Dialog (Dark)
variants.description: Invite dialog adapted for dark surfaces with the same invite row, member list, and copy-link structure.
accessibility: Member names, emails, role text, and the copy-link action must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
